NAME: Parity-Sieve Monoid
GENESIS: Quotienting a free monoid by the parity of its generators' weights.
FORMAL_SEED: $a \cdot b = c \iff \text{weight}(a) + \text{weight}(b) \equiv \text{weight}(c) \pmod 2$
STRANGE_PROPERTY: Multiplication preserves the topology of the word-length but annihilates the identity-path.
NEAREST_KNOWN_RELATIVE: $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded algebra
WHY_NOT_JUST_RENAMING: It lacks a scalar field; it is a pure combinatoric structure where "zero" is a set of paths, not a value.
COUNTERFEIT: Group Ring $\mathbb{Z}[\mathbb{Z}_2]$
BREAK_IT: Attempting to define a unique inverse for a non-zero weight element.
NEXT_MUTATION: Tensor-gluing via weight-mismatch.
END
